result.description:
Company: Fully Promoted Moorebank
ABN: 52 650 163 509
Position Opportunity: Multimedia Designer

About the Firm:

At Fully Promoted, we believe every brand deserves to make a strong, lasting impression and we
make that easy. With more than 20 years of experience and over 70 stores across Australia, we
partner with businesses, clubs, organisations, and teams to create branded uniforms, workwear, and
promotional products that truly reflect their identity. From corporate polos and hi-visibility safety
gear to sports uniforms, hospitality wear, and event apparel, our wide-ranging catalog ensures we
have the right solution for virtually any industry or need.

What sets Fully Promoted apart is our dedication to quality, flexibility, and service. We offer a variety
of customisation techniques — from embroidery and screen printing to vinyl heat transfers, dye
sublimation, and direct-to-film printing — so you can choose the look and budget that best matches
your brand. On top of that, we support our clients every step of the way: our showroom consultants
help you design the ideal uniform or merch lineup, and we even provide a dedicated online portal
for easy reordering and team-wide consistency.

Opportunity:

We are looking for a Multimedia Designer to be joining our dynamic team at Moorebank 2170 NSW.

Duties and Responsibilities:

As a Multimedia Designer you will be responsible for planning, designing and developing digital and
visual content that supports the company’s branding and marketing efforts. This includes creating
promotional content, preparing layouts and digital mock-ups by choosing appropriate media and
materials, and working alongside other stakeholders to ensure the design brief meets
communication objectives. As a multimedia designer we expect that you translate the brand
identity into compelling visuals to support marketing, sales and client communications.

The main the tasks of a Recruitment Consultant are, but not limited to:

? Clarify and define the design brief by meeting with clients or internal stakeholders to
understand what the design needs to achieve, and what constraints exist.
? Design digital and print marketing materials such as catalogues of uniform lines, promotional
brochures, online ads, social media graphics, product images, and videos demonstrating
uniform features or brand stories.
? Research and analyse communication needs by study what the audience or end-users need
to see or receive, and evaluate what media will communicate best.
? Develop design concepts by creating ideas for visuals, layouts, illustrations, graphics, or
multimedia content that convey the brand’s identity and message.
? Manage digital asset library to keep up-to-date templates, design files, logos, and branding
guidelines to enable efficient reorders, consistent branding across products, and flexible
customisation for different clients.
? Participate in client consultations to help clients visualise how their brand will look on
uniforms or promotional merchandise via mockups or digital renders, helping them decide
colors, placement, materials, and design style.
? Prepare design assets by producing sketches, diagrams, illustrations, digital mock-ups,
layouts and other preparatory materials to represent the design for clients or internal
review.
? Select media and materials and make decisions about what media and what functional
materials best suit the projects.
? Document and detail design specifications to prepare production-ready documentation and
specifications in terms of colors, dimensions, file formats, and layout instructions.
? Oversee or carry out production by managing and executing the creation of final media such
as print and digital, video, or other multimedia formats.
? Archive and manage design assets to maintain a stored, organised record of design files and
assets that can be reused for future reorders or additional promotional materials.
? Design digital and print marketing materials such as catalogues of uniform lines, promotional
brochures, online ads, social media graphics, product images, and videos demonstrating
uniform features or brand stories.

Education and Previous Experience Required:

? Tertiary education in Multimedia Design or co-related field.
? At least 2 years of full-time working experience in the same role or co-related roles.

Skills Required:

? Strong creative thinking and concept-development abilities
